changes.what: quiet also asks the cycle after the span
a look-back of d is met one cycle early
a look-back of d needs d + 1 cycles
once keeps a cycle that was a reset
hist keeps a cycle that was a reset
since asks its first operand one cycle early
% truncates
>> truncates
<< of a vector keeps every bit
isspace is the space alone
upper moves every letter
a trigger counts before it is defined
next keeps a trigger in a reset cycle
within opens one cycle late
hold_until: a release in the checked cycle ends it
bounded_wait allows one cycle more
after_reset also asks the cycles of a long reset
a verdict counts in a reset cycle
a trigger counts in a reset cycle
checked in reset too: a verdict counts before its look-back
checked in reset too: a trigger counts before its look-back
a reset does not set the ghosts
the range of a ghost is asked in reset too
